work: Poster, logo, badges, wine labels, festival trophy

poster.text: Two details from this painting became the whole system: the dancing figures on its screen and the 22.

w:logo-switch.text: The 22 is a film strip, drawn by hand, in white and in black.

billboard-tower.text: Eleven days across two sites: the TCL Chinese Theatres and Ovation Hollywood.

sign-red-carpet.text: The figures do the wayfinding: the Red Carpet sign on Hollywood Boulevard, the walkway towers, the theater signs and the VIP room.
sign-red-carpet.src: work[1]; the VIP room from daltoncorr.com

wine-lineup-all.text: The labels came from the poster. Artiste Winery bottled a Sauvignon Blanc, a Chardonnay and a Cabernet Sauvignon for the festival.

w:phones-stage.text: Online, the campaign ran to hundreds of graphics under the same direction.

trophy-hand.text: The trophy is a film-strip frame that holds the winning film's own poster.
